property_summary: For every call to play with any msg.value, the reference C never reverts (it only requires equality to TICKET_AMOUNT which the fuzzer will satisfy or else the call reverts) — tighten domain to only values NOT equal to TICKET_AMOUNT so reference and mutant differ in whether they accept those values: the reference reverts when msg.value != TICKET_AMOUNT, while the mutant accepts them; therefore for all admissible inputs (msg.value != TICKET_AMOUNT) the reference will revert (call fails) but the mutant will succeed, so asserting that play reverts for msg.value != TICKET_AMOUNT holds for the reference and is violated by the mutant for some input.
change_summary: Change the required ticket amount check from equality to inequality, allowing any value except the ticket amount and thus altering pot updates and payouts.
